title: Signal: Weak hash function (MD5) — review required
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches a bare md5( call regardless of purpose, and never matches dotted calls (hashlib.md5, Digest::MD5 style) — those belong to language-specific rules. SHA-1 and other weak algorithms are separate rules.
